title: Unique Charred Syrian Asparagus Skewers
description: Charred and juicy asparagus skewers with a Syrian twist, perfect for a crowd-pleasing vegetarian dish, featuring tadka for added flavor.

ingredients.name: tadka spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, sumac, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the asparagus to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the asparagus onto skewers, leaving a small space between each spear.
Grill the asparagus skewers for 3-4 minutes per side, or until charred and tender.
While the asparagus is grilling, heat the tadka spices in a small pan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Once the asparagus is done, brush the tadka spices over the skewers.
Serve the charred asparagus skewers hot, garnished with additional sumac and paprika if desired.
